# #3613: Patch: follow-up to #3464 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3464 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3464 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42746562979)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`efe8cdab2ebe`). `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3464 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/cards/art/richness.ts:54`: ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX is 40, but fixtures/art-detail-short.json now names only 10 ids. That breaks the cap's documented ratchet ('its length as the last pass left it, so it can only shrink'), and R3352000 and the patch fragment's notes both record the cap wrongly.
  Evidence: At HEAD, art-detail-short.json holds 10 stinkyscape ids. The base fixture had 101 lines (99 ids) and this change removed 89. The doc comment above ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX says the cap equals the list's length after each pass, and every earlier pass followed that (561, 445, 337, 289, 157, 129). spec/rulings/R3352000.md says the cap 'falls from 129 to 40, the list's length as this issue left it', which is false: it is 10. spec/pending/3352.md says the same. crates/cards/patches/pending/every-classic-card-drawn-as-what-it-is-a-scene-3352.json `notes` says 'whose cap falls from 157 to 68', which matches neither the code nor the ruling. artRichness.test.ts only checks `listed.length <= ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX`, so 30 new shortfalls could join the list without the cap noticing. Fix: set the cap to 10, add '10 after #3352' to the doc comment's history, and correct the numbers in R3352000.md, spec/pending/3352.md and the fragment's `notes`.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
